title: FLA import: readCPicSwf is not defined — pages 1/6/7/8 import as empty scenes, game stuck on blank first scene
description:
readCPicSwf was implemented in commit e955bb8 as part of the CPicSwf support work:

- Added Fla8SwfRef interface and readCPicSwf() function to flash8-binary.ts
- Case 'CPicSwf' in deserializeClass() now calls readCPicSwf() instead of falling through to the default/skipped handler
- flash8-import.ts handles 'swf' type elements gracefully (logs a warning, returns null)

Pages 1/6/7/8 containing CPicSwf placements now parse successfully — the ReferenceError is gone. The CPicSwf objects themselves are skipped (no display object model for embedded SWF assets), but the rest of the page content (AS2 scripts, other objects) parses correctly.

Verified: 303 test files pass, 4776 tests. Build clean.
